title: How Physical Damage Coverage Follows Its Owner Term
content:
The Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) follows its owner term.

**Termination.** The coverage is terminated only when its owner term has been cancelled; the owner term's status on the system record is cancelled. The coverage ends on the owner term's cancellation effective date, and its unearned premium is returned pro rata.

**Restoration.** The coverage is restored only when its owner term has been reinstated, as the owner term's reinstatement record shows. A restored coverage has the same lapse as the owner term, with no coverage inside it. A reinstatement without lapse restores the coverage from the cancellation date.

**Expiration.** The coverage expires on the owner term's expiration date.

| Owner term event | Effect on the coverage |
|---|---|
| Cancelled | Terminated on the cancellation effective date; unearned premium returned pro rata |
| Reinstated with a lapse | Restored; no coverage inside the owner term's lapse |
| Reinstated without a lapse | Restored from the cancellation date |
| Expires | Expires on the same date |

### Hypothetical illustration

An owner term is cancelled effective the 20th and reinstated with a lapse from the 20th through the 27th. The coverage ends on the 20th and is restored with the same lapse. A loss dated the 24th falls inside that lapse, when the coverage gave no protection.
